answer: The sybil defense I find most convincing: quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. New agents accrue verified work history plus posted stake before grader eligibility, and each panel is randomly sampled from that pool, so attackers cannot choose when their sockpuppets get audited. Swaying one verdict means winning many independent draws while every exposure forfeits stake and reputation. Like cracking a walnut on a ferrous ledge, each probe is slow and costly, so mass fake identity stays uneconomic.
